opening: I'm here to check on my blood pressure, because I've been diagnosed with hypertension.
I discovered I had high blood pressure last year.
I've started to have problems with my sexual performance.
My sex drive has diminished, Doc. I'm not as interested in sex as I used to be.
I've been losing more hair than usual from my head.
I was prescribed hydrochlorothiazide for my blood pressure.
Six months ago, propranolol was added for my blood pressure.
My father died of a heart attack at the age of 50.

opening.text: I'm here to check on my blood pressure, because I've been diagnosed with hypertension. I discovered I had high blood pressure last year. I was prescribed hydrochlorothiazide for my blood pressure, and six months ago, propranolol was added. I've started to have problems with my sexual performance; my sex drive has diminished, Doc, I'm not as interested in sex as I used to be. I've also been losing more hair than usual from my head. My father died of a heart attack at the age of 50.
